memberdef.name: computePpr

briefdescription.para: Compute Personalized PageRank (PPR) scores for all nodes in a process model graph, seeded from seed_node_ids.

detaileddescription.para: PPR handles multi-hop queries better than BFS by propagating relevance across the entire graph with exponential distance decay.
Uses power iteration: r=α*A^T*r+(1-α)*personalization Terminates when ||r_new − r_old||₁ < PprConfig::convergence_epsilon or after PprConfig::max_iterations steps.

parameterdescription.para: Starting nodes (personalisation vector is uniform over these nodes).

simplesect.para: Top-k (node_id, ppr_score) pairs sorted descending by score.
